page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. This network capacity supports reliable communication with external databases and storage volumes.

The hardware profile of the ecs.g5.16xlarge makes it suitable for workloads requiring balanced compute and memory resources without local storage dependencies. Typical deployment scenarios include enterprise application servers, medium-to-large web serving environments, containerized microservices, and distributed caching layers.
